findings.title: Inward soundness as a returnable direction
findings.claim: In 17:25, inward content, conditional soundness, recurrent return, and abundant forgiveness form a reading of goodness as a direction resumed after error; the wider return-and-repair passages place forgiveness with those who return.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrences at 17:25:5:1, 17:25:8:1, 17:25:11:3, and 17:25:12:1 meet supplied wider contexts that pair divine knowledge with hidden intent, return and repair after wrongdoing, and forgiveness with protection. The contrasting turn-away-after-relief in 39:8 makes recurrent return a resumed direction rather than an uninterrupted record. The 38:25 connection adds a good return-place beside forgiveness.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the condition as inward soundness expressed through renewed repair, rather than a polished record. The returning-person image becomes a lived reorientation, and forgiveness protects that return while remaining bounded by the supplied judgment context.
findings.containment: The focus's plain conditional and divine attribute remain intact. This does not make forgiveness an automatic acquittal: 3:129 keeps punishment and forgiveness together. The physical-cover branch is excluded.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding and exact focus occurrences ground the inward-return-repair core. Connection rows supply target Arabic but explicitly omit target morphology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Nufusikum carries the focus phrase's inward content: thought, intention, or knowledge held within the selves.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 53:32 connection pairs divine knowledge with refusal of self-purification; 25:6 pairs knowledge of the hidden with forgiveness.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's inward-selves carrier meets wider statements that God's knowledge reaches hidden moral content and that people do not certify their own purity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The condition of soundness is legible as an inward orientation known beyond public appearance or self-description.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not disclose any reader's actual intent or claim that human readers can inspect it.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: Salihin predicates a condition of being sound and good within the focus's open conditional.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:5, 6:54, and 25:70 connections place return and repaired action after wrongdoing alongside forgiveness.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's soundness predicate meets wider cases where a person turns back and acts rightly after a wrong, letting the state include a repaired course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Soundness can remain a real condition while being understood as recoverable after error.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that every wrong is repaired or that a later return erases accountability.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: Salihin carries the focus's soundness predicate, with the branch extension allowing a damaged condition to be put right.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connection texts describe return and reform after wrongdoing, including righteous action after grave wrongdoing in 25:70.
branch_activations.activation: The repair actions in those contexts meet the focus's soundness carrier and shift it from a static appearance to a state that can be restored through action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The conditional can describe people becoming sound through repair as well as people already in a sound condition.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual extension; it does not replace the ordinary sense of being good and sound.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel çekirdek, bir kişinin veya şeyin geri dönmesi ve önceki ya da beklenen varış yerine yönelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-awwabin names habitual returners; this branch carries returning toward a previous or expected destination.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 24:5, 6:54, and 25:70 connections describe return after wrongdoing; 39:8 supplies the turn toward God followed by forgetting after relief.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's returner label meets both repaired returns and a contrary departure after benefit, so recurrent return reads as a direction resumed after fluctuation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The returners can be understood through renewed orientation after departure, which lets conditional soundness include repair rather than imply an uninterrupted record.
branch_activations.boundary: The 39:8 context does not establish that every returner has turned away or that every lapse is forgiven.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dönüşün kendisi yanında dönüş zamanı ve dönüş yeri de aynı anlam alanına girer.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The forgiveness given to returners resonates with arrival at a good return-place as well as with the act of turning back.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection supports a return-place image only; it does not generalize the branch's well or mill specializations.

findings.title: Formative care beside inward knowledge
findings.claim: The focus title rabbukum can carry formative care alongside its ordinary Lord-title: the wider account of human formation in 53:32 places divine knowledge of the inward self beside a process that unfolds over time.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 17:25:1:1 is the addressed Rabb-title. The 53:32 connection supplies the sequence of creation from earth and embryonic life, then divine knowledge and a warning against self-purification. That staged formation activates the focus branch of gradual nurturing; its contact with the focus's knowledge of inner selves places knowing within formative care.
findings.reader_payoff: The title can suggest more than authority over the addressees: the one who knows inward states is also heard beside the process by which human beings are formed.
findings.containment: This is a juxtaposition of formative care and inward knowledge, not a claim that nurture causes moral repair or that 17:25 describes a causal audit. The ordinary addressed Lord-title remains present.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and focus occurrence are supplied, and 53:32 provides exact target Arabic, but the connection packet has no target morphology and the formative contact is an independently composed interpretation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
branch_activations.carrier: Rabbukum is the focus's addressed Lord-title and carries the focus branch of gradual nurturing and completion.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 53:32 Arabic describes human formation from earth and embryonic life before pairing divine knowledge with inward accountability.
branch_activations.activation: That staged formation meets the Rabb carrier and the focus's inward-knowledge clause, placing divine knowing beside formative care.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Lord who knows what is within can also be heard as the one who forms human beings over time.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supports juxtaposition, not a causal claim that formative care produces a particular moral state.

findings.title: Conditional human state beside established forgiveness
findings.claim: The focus's conditional takunu and established kana clause meet a wider return-after-wrong context in 25:70, where repaired human action is followed by the established divine attribute of forgiveness.
findings.mechanism: The focus has two exact occurrences of the being branch: 17:25:7:1 in the conditional about human soundness and 17:25:10:1 in the clause stating God's forgiving attribute. The supplied 25:70 connection describes return and righteous action after wrongdoing before wa kana Allahu ghafuran rahiman; the parallel brings the contingent human course and established attribute into contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold open the human condition together with an established divine attribute, so repair after error remains possible without making forgiveness automatic.
findings.containment: The wider target morphology is not supplied, and 25:70 does not reproduce the focus's exact conditional syntax. The connection supports the pairing, not a universal promise or a claim that every wrong is erased.

epistemic.reason: Both focus occurrences and their morphology are supplied, while 25:70's exact Arabic and connection note are supplied without target-side morphology or a trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Takunu presents human soundness as a conditional state; kana states the divine attribute as established in the focus clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 25:70 connection places repentance and righteous action after wrongdoing before wa kana Allahu ghafuran rahiman.
branch_activations.activation: The wider human-return sequence meets the focus's two forms of being and reinforces the difference between a contingent human condition and an established divine attribute.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human soundness remains a condition that can be resumed through return, while forgiveness is presented as an established divine attribute.
branch_activations.boundary: This parallel does not equate the two ayat or guarantee forgiveness for every action.

findings.title: Rectitude as restored relationship
findings.claim: Alongside an inward condition of soundness, the focus's salihin can meet a wider reconciliation image in which a strained human relation is repaired and forgiveness follows.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 17:25:8:1 predicates soundness of the addressees. The supplied 4:129 connection places a repair/reconciliation clause after a description of unequal treatment between wives and pairs it with mindfulness and forgiveness. Contact with the focus's salihin branch B002 makes goodness legible as the restoration of a damaged relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Salihin can carry a social edge: being sound may include making peace and restoring a relation, in addition to the inward repair described elsewhere.
findings.containment: This contextual resonance does not make 17:25 an instruction about marriage or displace the personal and inward readings. Target morphology is not supplied, so the relation remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and branch facets are exact; 4:129 supplies target Arabic and an authored relation note but no target morphology or source-trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
branch_activations.carrier: Salihin carries the focus predicate of being good and sound, with the focus root also providing a reconciliation branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 4:129 context describes strained marital relations, then an act of repair/reconciliation alongside mindfulness and forgiveness.
branch_activations.activation: The relational repair in the wider context meets the focus's soundness carrier and activates the branch in which conflict between people is corrected.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's condition of soundness can include restoring a damaged human relation.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not transfer the specific marital setting of 4:129 into 17:25.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.
branch_activations.carrier: Salihin is the focus's plural predicate for sound persons.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 4:129 connection couples repair between parties with a movement away from unequal treatment and toward mindfulness.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's soundness predicate meets a wider case where parties make peace, adding reciprocal reconciliation to the moral condition.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rectitude can be heard as relational peace-making as well as an individual's inward condition.
branch_activations.boundary: This branch remains a coexisting resonance; it does not select reconciliation as the only sense of salihin.

findings.title: Habitual return and final return
findings.claim: The focus's plural habitual returners meet a wider statement of the final return to God, distinguishing recurrent turning within a life from the return that awaits everyone.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 17:25:11:3 names habitual returners. The exact 88:25 target Arabic states that their return is to God, and its connection note contrasts this final compelled return with the focus's returning persons. The two uses meet through return but differ in temporal scope.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's returner name becomes a disposition practiced before the final return, rather than a synonym for that universal endpoint.
findings.containment: The connection note calls the 88:25 return compelled, while the supplied target Arabic contains only the return statement and no target morphology. The temporal contrast is therefore qualified and does not import a wider eschatological account.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch carrier and 88:25 Arabic are supplied; the connection note provides the contrast, but the target-side morphology and continuation are absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel çekirdek, bir kişinin veya şeyin geri dönmesi ve önceki ya da beklenen varış yerine yönelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-awwabin names the focus's habitual returners.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 88:25 Arabic states that the return is to God; the connection note frames it as a final, compelled return.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's recurrent returners meet the wider final-return statement, and their shared destination highlights a difference between practiced return and the final return.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus can describe a recurring disposition before the universal final return, not merely the fact that everyone eventually returns.
branch_activations.boundary: The final/compelled characterization is attributed to the connection note; the packet supplies no target morphology or continuation beyond 88:25.
